description: Namur - Interventions voies publiques is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Inventaire des demandes d'intervention sur la voie publique faites entre 2009 et 2022. Il s'agit de toutes les interventions traitées pour le nettoyage de la voie publique, la réparation locale de voirie, avaloirs bouchés, etc. Chaque demande est caractérisée par un thème et est localisée dans une rue. Coverage: Namur. The portal files it under Urbanisme, Patrimoine, Administration et Services publics. Its keywords are Nid de poule, poteau, entretien, réparation, défectueux, ramassage. The portal shows 41,983 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-12-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
